instruction_interpretation: The owner authorizes a THIRD $7.00 reservation and one launch for the checked-component pilot, on the condition the owner set with the instruction: fix what the failures exposed, and run again only if the package rehearsal passes. The condition is met - the rehearsal now builds the deployed artifact, unpacks it and executes both conditions from the unpacked layout (9 passed). It also found, before any reservation, a fourth and a fifth defect that would each have destroyed an attempt: the packaged worker had no pinned cube bundle (CUBE_BUNDLE_FILE_MISSING), and the worker's checkpoint verifier hashed parameter names as well as bytes and so could never equal GraphLearner.checkpoint_identity (CANDIDATE_CHECKPOINT_NOT_VERIFIED after the full update budget). Same frozen design, conditions, limits and reservation amount as OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_CANDIDATE_PILOT_001.json and _002.json; only the job name, the source commit, the package and the receipt directory differ, because the ledger already holds the attempt-003 and attempt-004 jobs and a job is never reserved twice.

authorization_context: Same pilot as OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_CANDIDATE_PILOT_001.json, restated in short: two conditions from matched initial weights - checked_component_teaching (40 component plus 24 whole-answer corrections per 64 updates) and final_answer_only (0 plus 64, frozen round-robin 22/21/21) - 64 updates each, 128 total, seed 20260909, arm cas, ordering mode declared, separate optimizer states and checkpoints, the same frozen encoder, framing and scoring. Data: eight teaching records covering seven distinct questions and a common 44-question untaught probe evaluated after each condition's final checkpoint with no update. Reporting: before and after, the three taught whole-answer questions as the primary set with all three scores and the loss, the five component questions separately, and the probe by operation; independent and assisted never merged; missing values unavailable. Interpretation bound: how to spend a fixed budget, not adding component instruction at equal final-question practice; a negative result never means the seven-stage program failed.
